data.action: 站在设计台前查看蓝图
data.description: 【调月莉音 · 研讨会设计蓝图】千年研讨会会长办公室内，莉音伫立在巨大的全息交互蓝图前，如墨的长发垂落腰际，血红色的眼眸严谨地推演着每一条数据流。听见开门声，她微微侧头推了推镜架——「你来了，老师。我在推演千年未来三年的算力规划……不过既然你来了，这份计划可以为你腾出第一顺位的预算。」
data.promptProse: Rio studies a huge interactive blueprint in the Seminar president's office, tracing its data routes with focused red eyes before turning and adjusting her glasses. Her high-neck sweater, pleated skirt and wristwatch remain in the slightly low medium view. The projection extends beside her toward rear control surfaces. Cool-white ceiling light defines her long dark hair, while screen glow brightens her fingertips and the underside of the watch.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 研讨会设计蓝图
